Bay Area Winery DJ -The Vineyards at Nella Terra Cellars


Wedding Ceremony and Reception – Sunol – Bay Area Winery DJ

Wedding Party the order will be Micheal Denevan and Cassandra Hovell, Mattie Vukmir and Sean Marraffa, Brooke Houston and Sean Blanda (Best Man MOH).

Songs to add to the Dance List will be
Scream and Shout by Will.i.am
Party in the USA by Miley Cyrus
The Man by Aloe Blacc
Dynamite by Taio Cruz
Your love is my drug by Kesha
Ignition Remix by R Kelly
Hot in Herre by Nelly
Shake it by Metro Station
Here I go again by Whitesnake
Superfreak by Rick James
When I grow up by the pussycat dolls.

Mother Son dance will be simple man by Lynyrd Skynyrd.
